speakerBios.Andy Baker: Andy Baker is the local preacher at the Arnold church of Christ in Arnold, Missouri. He is a former public school teacher, a former youth minister, and a former opera and musical singer. He holds a Bachelor of Music with a double major in English, and also a Master of Arts in Music Education from Stephen F. Austin State University. He taught public school in Plano, Texas for a few years before attending Southwest School of Bible Studies in Austin, Texas in 2006. With his beautiful wife, Kathryn they have two sweet daughters and a wonderful boy.
speakerBios.Bart Warren:
Bart has been preaching full-time since 2003 and has served congregations in Tennessee and Kentucky (at the South Green Street Church of Christ in Glasgow, KY since 2010). He has taught at preacher training schools in both Tennessee (Southeast Institute of Biblical Studies) and Colorado (Bear Valley Bible Institute). He is Vice-President of Warren Christian Apologetics Center and is the associate editor of an apologetics journal, Sufficient Evidence.

He is married to Laura (Hanstein), and they have three boys: Ike & Jet (twins) and Jake.
speakerBios.Bill Burk:
Bill is a 1993 graduate of the Browntrail School of Preaching and has served as an adjunct teacher there since 1995. He has preached for three congregations in Texas: Rendon (1994–1997), Seagoville (1997–2010), and the Crandall Church of Christ (2011 until present). He is a 2024 graduate of South African Theological Seminary with a Bachelor of Theology.

Bill is married to Leda, and they have three daughters, BreAnna, Bella, and Brook.
speakerBios.Caleb Colley: Caleb Colley is the pulpit minister for the North Jackson Church of Christ in Jackson, Tennessee. He is a graduate of Freed-Hardeman University, where he received a B.A. in communication, a B.S. in biblical studies (2006), and an M.A. in New Testament (2021). He also received a Master's degree in humanities from Faulkner University, and a Ph.D. in philosophy from the University of South Carolina (2014). Caleb has taught in the Graduate School of Theology at FHU, the Georgia School of Preaching, and in the Philosophy Department at the University of South Carolina. He is married to the former Rebekah Meinsen, and they have a daughter (Maggie) and a son (Ellis).
speakerBios.Carla Moore: Carla grew up in a family dedicated to ministry, then met John while they were in college at Texas State University. They married in 1986, and have since been involved in ministry at the Bible Chair on the campus of TSU, then with the Southwest School of Bible Studies in Austin and then with the Dripping Springs church of Christ in Dripping Springs, Texas. They currently work with the Bear Valley Bible Institute. Carla taught for more than ten years in the Christian Women's Studies program at the Southwest School of Bible Studies and currently teaches in the women's program at Bear Valley Bible Institute. She enjoys speaking to women of all ages in various places, and is a staff writer for Christian Woman. She is the author of the blog Walking Where Jesus Walked and The Scripture Writing Project.
speakerBios.Dan Winkler:
Dan Winkler was born in Port Arthur, TX, the eldest son of Wendell and Betty Winkler. In 1971, he married his high school sweetheart, Diane, and the Lord blessed them with the joy of raising three wonderful sons.

Dan graduated from Oklahoma Christian College with a BA in Bible, minoring in Greek and Speech. He secured his Masters degree from David Lipscomb College with an emphasis in New Testament studies. He has been preaching since 1969 and also served as a member of the Freed-Hardeman University Bible faculty for almost a decade and a half before retiring in 2018.

Brother Dan has authored twenty books, serves as Question and Answer editor for the Magnolia Messenger, and co-hosts the popular podcast Today With Jesus, viewed by thousands in twenty-five different countries.
speakerBios.Glenn Hitchcock:
Glenn Hitchcock was born in Newport News, Va. He is married to the former Mercedes Dowson (51 years) and they have one daughter, Lauren. The Hitchcocks resided in Hampton, Virginia and are members of the Peninsula church of Christ where Glenn served as one of her elders.

Glenn is a 1982 graduate of the Memphis School of Preaching and a 1988 graduate of Saint Leo College with a B.A. He completed graduate education in 1995 from Norfolk State University School of Social Work. Glenn is a United States honorably discharged Air Force veteran (1972–1980).

Since 1996, Glenn has edited a weekly devotional, "Thoughts For Today To Brighten Your Day." Glenn retired from healthcare in 2019, and he still conducts meetings, marriage seminars and workshops as his schedule permits.
speakerBios.John Moore:
A native of Dripping Springs, Texas, John has served as an evangelist, teacher, preacher and minister of the gospel for over 30 years. He and his wife Carla are working with Bear Valley Bible Institute International, and serve as the directors of Bible Passages, a ministry dedicated to training preachers, equipping the saints, defending the faith, and guiding souls to Jesus. He is the narrator and author of both the book and video Searching For Truth, and directs the Bible Land Passages Project. Since 1986 John has preached in Gospel Meetings in over eighteen states, and has conducted or participated in yearly campaigns to various foreign countries including Jamaica, Tobago, Malaysia, and Singapore.

John and Carla have three sons and five grandchildren.
speakerBios.Kathy Pollard: Kathy is married to Neal Pollard, who preaches for the Lehman Ave. church of Christ in Bowling Green, KY. They have three grown sons, all married, and two new grandsons with another grandchild on the way! Kathy attended Faulkner University and Bear Valley Bible Institute and has a bachelor's degree in Bible. She is a writer for Christian Woman magazine, contributes the Bible-marking feature at comefillyourcup.com, and is the author of the book Return to Me…What to Do When Loved Ones Fall Away. She and Carla Moore host a weekly podcast for Christian women called Looking Up. Kathy enjoys spending time with family, traveling to Israel, tending her gardens, and getting to know her new dairy cow, Peaches.
speakerBios.Mike Vestal: Mike has served the Westside congregation in Midland, TX for almost 24 years. He and his wife Cherie met at Freed-Hardeman University and they have been married since 1983. They are blessed with 2 children and 4 grandchildren. Their son David preaches for the Lord's church in Mathis, TX. Mike has preached in 37 different states and in 6 foreign countries. He often speaks on brotherhood programs such as PTP and Focal Point. Mike currently serves as an adjunct instructor at Bear Valley Bible Institute in Denver, CO.
speakerBios.Parker Webster: Parker is the preaching minister for the North Lexington Church of Christ in Lexington, KY. Prior to living in Kentucky, he served as the minister for the Carriage Oaks church of Christ in Bossier City, LA. Parker is the son of Wade and Jennifer Webster. He is married to the former Sabrina Rodriguez of Arlington, Texas. Parker is a graduate of the Southwest School of Biblical Studies in Austin, Texas and Harbinger Theological Seminary in Nashville, TN. Sabrina graduated from Texas State University with an Accounting degree. Parker and Sabrina recently welcomed their first child, Greyson Wade.
speakerBios.Richard Melson:
Richard D. Melson is a native of Buffalo, NY and has preached the gospel since 1981. He serves as the evangelist at the Needmore Road church of Christ, Dayton, Ohio. He is a former elder in the Lord's church. Richard is an instructor at the Central Carolina School of Preaching (Sumter, SC), and is the host of Landmarks For Living, a radio program in Dayton. He has done campaign work in various countries, spoken on numerous brotherhood lectureships and held many gospel meetings in various states over the years.

Richard and Valerie (Miller) have been married since 1979 and have four children who are all members of the Lord's church, and seven grandchildren.
speakerBios.Tim Lewis: Tim is a graduate of Oklahoma Christian University. He graduated in 1993 with a degree in English Education and obtained his Master's Degree in Ministry in 1998. He served as the Preacher/Youth Minister for the Mt. Vernon church of Christ in Mt. Vernon, Missouri for 8 years before moving to Oklahoma City to begin his work with the North MacArthur congregation in 2004. He has written a book entitled The Domino Effect: Changing Your Life One Decision at a Time. Tim and his wife, Tawni, have two daughters, Macy and Callie, and one son Ryder.
